blocks.text: Nomenclature compounds ke naam rakhne ka nizam hai. Yeh hissa IUPAC usoolon se alkanes (paraffins), un ke alkyl groups aur cycloalkanes ke naam rakhta hai, 11.2.1 mein alkane homologous series se shuru kar ke, 11.2.2 mein shakhdar (branched) alkanes ke usool aur 11.2.3 mein cycloalkanes.

blocks.prompt: Organic chemistry ko ba-zabta (IUPAC) nomenclature ki zaroorat kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Mumkin hydrocarbons ki tadaad carbons ki tadaad ke saath bohat barh jati hai, aur bohat se ek hi molecular formula rakhte hain. Sab se lambi zanjeer, number shuda positions aur substituents se bana ba-zabta naam ek structure ko be-shubha pehchanta hai, jo isobutane jaise aam naam bare molecules ke liye nahi kar sakte.

items: IUPAC nomenclature alkanes, alkyl groups aur cycloalkanes ke naam ba-zabta rakhti hai (11.2.1 se 11.2.3).
